from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "Prerequisite Recap: The Slope of Change"
        lines = [
            "Differentiation helps us calculate the rate of change.",
            "Graphically, the derivative is the slope of the tangent.",
            "It transforms a position function into a velocity function."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        POSITION_COLOR = "#ADD8E6"
        VELOCITY_COLOR = "#FFA500"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "Differentiation helps us calculate the rate of change."
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR))
        
        # Create axes for the graph
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 5, 1],
            y_range=[0, 5, 1],
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": WHITE},
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B2", "E5")
        
        # Position-time curve (a hiker climbing)
        # f(x) = 0.2*x^2
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.2 * x**2, x_range=[0, 4.5], color=POSITION_COLOR)
        
        # Labels for axes
        x_label = Text("Time (t)", font_size=16).next_to(axes.x_axis, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        y_label = Text("Position (s)", font_size=16).rotate(90 * DEGREES).next_to(axes.y_axis, LEFT, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(axes), Create(x_label), Create(y_label))
        self.play(Create(curve))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "Graphically, the derivative is the slope of the tangent."
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Tangent point at t=3
        t_val = 3.0
        point_on_curve = axes.c2p(t_val, 0.2 * t_val**2)
        dot = Dot(point_on_curve, color=WHITE)
        
        # Tangent line
        tangent = axes.get_tangent_line(t_val, curve, length=3, color=POSITION_COLOR)
        
        # Zooming lens (Circle)
        lens = Circle(radius=0.8, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)
        lens.move_to(point_on_curve)
        
        self.play(Create(dot))
        self.play(Create(lens))
        self.play(Create(tangent))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "It transforms a position function into a velocity function."
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Change tangent color to represent velocity
        self.play(tangent.animate.set_color(VELOCITY_COLOR))
        
        # Label for the tangent slope
        velocity_label = Text("Velocity (Derivative)", font_size=18, color=VELOCITY_COLOR)
        # Position label near the tangent line in the grid
        self.place_at_grid(velocity_label, "D5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(velocity_label))
        self.wait(2)

        # Reset colors for final state
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)
